# jikjoken-sys

C FFI bindings for TikToken, designed for Julia interop.

## Overview

This crate wraps OpenAI's TikToken Rust implementation with C-compatible FFI bindings,
allowing Julia to call the fast BPE tokenization code directly via `ccall`.

## Architecture

```
Julia (JikJoken.jl)
    ↓ ccall
C FFI (this crate)
    ↓ Rust function calls
TikToken Core (deps/tiktoken)
```

## Building

```bash
cargo build --release
```

This generates:
- `target/release/libjikjoken.{so,dylib,dll}` - Shared library for Julia
- `include/jikjoken.h` - C header file (auto-generated by cbindgen)

## API

The C API exposes the following functions:

- `jikjoken_encoding_new()` - Create a new encoding
- `jikjoken_encoding_free()` - Free an encoding
- `jikjoken_encode_ordinary()` - Encode text without special tokens
- `jikjoken_encode()` - Encode text with special token control
- `jikjoken_decode_bytes()` - Decode tokens to bytes
- `jikjoken_bytes_free()` - Free decoded bytes
- `jikjoken_special_tokens()` - Get special tokens
- `jikjoken_special_tokens_free()` - Free special tokens
- `jikjoken_tokens_free()` - Free token array
- `jikjoken_version()` - Get version string

## Memory Management

The caller is responsible for freeing all allocated memory using the appropriate `*_free` functions.

## Thread Safety

The underlying TikToken code is thread-safe for encoding/decoding operations.
